meta.label: Week 9 · Thursday
meta.model_version: v3.0 · ESPN rebuild (questions kept or cut out of sample)
meta.prices_et: DraftKings lines and openers via ESPN, Thu Nov 5 early afternoon ET · prices not posted
meta.injuries_et: ESPN injury report and depth chart, Thu Nov 5 12:26 PM ET

calibration.note: calib_nfl.py: widen by K, then anchor to the two-sided no-vig market. No prices tonight, so no anchor and no edge.

rules: 25D score above +1.5 for an over or at most −1.5 for an under.
Projection on the bet side of the line.
Play chance of at least 50% from the ESPN injury report.
Calibrated edge of at least 5 points over the break-even of the best price (needs both sides priced).
Projection and line within 50% of each other.
Pattern check (gradient-boosted trees) does not disagree.
meta.staking: Model sizing: 1 unit flat (1u = 1% of bankroll). 0.5u for QB rushing and prices of +300 or longer.

funnel.step: Strong or weak report card on that side
Priced, so the market check can run

meta.histogram_note: Histograms show 10,000 replays per prop after the K widening. Ranges are calibrated so the 80% range covered about 80% of 2026 games the model never saw.
meta.method: Questions: the NFL Slate 25 per prop, pooled with research-backed candidates, then kept only if they improved held-out seasons, kept their sign, and were not near-duplicates. Data: ESPN box scores 2021–2026 organized as player × game × stat and defense × game × stat tensors; defenses denoised by low-rank projection; player roles by non-negative CP decomposition.
